pairs: Then, behold, Korah the son of Izhar,
et Dathan atque Abiron filii Eliab,
with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab,
Hon quoque filius Pheleth de filiis Ruben,
and also On the son of Peleth, of the sons of Ruben,
aliique filiorum Israël ducenti quinquaginta viri proceres synagogæ,
with two hundred fifty others of the sons of Israel, leading men of the assembly,
et qui tempore concilii per nomina vocabantur.
and who, at the time of a council, would be called by name.
Cumque stetissent adversum Moysen et Aaron,
And when they had stood against Moses
“Let it be sufficient for you that the entire multitude is of holy ones,
and that the Lord is among them.
Why do you elevate yourselves above the people of the Lord?”
he fell prone on his face.
notum faciet Dominus qui ad se pertineant,
the Lord will cause it to be known who belongs to him,
and which holy ones he will join to himself.
they shall be close to him.
tollat unusquisque thuribula sua, tu Core,
Each one of you, Korah and all your associates,
and drawing fire into it tomorrow,
place incense upon it before the Lord.
You sons of Levi have been raised up greatly.”
And he said again to Korah:
num parum vobis est quod separavit vos Deus Israël ab omni populo,
Is it a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from all the people,
and has joined you to himself,
ut serviretis ei in cultu tabernaculi,
so that you would serve him in the rituals of the tabernacle,
and stand before gatherings of the people,
idcirco ad se fecit accedere te et omnes fratres tuos filios Levi,
Was the reason that he caused you and all your brothers, the sons of Levi, to approach him,
so that you would even claim for yourselves the priesthood too,
et omnis globus tuus stet contra Dominum?
and so that your entire group would stand against the Lord?
quid est enim Aaron ut murmuretis contra eum?
For what is Aaron that you should murmur against him?”
Misit ergo Moyses ut vocaret Dathan et Abiron filios Eliab.
Therefore, Moses sent to call for Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab,
Numquid parum est tibi quod eduxisti nos de terra,
Is it a small matter to you,
that you have led us away from a land that was flowing with milk and honey,
so as to kill us in the desert,
unless you could also be a ruler over us?
You have led us, it is true,
quæ fluit rivis lactis et mellis,
to a land that flows with streams of milk and honey,
et dedisti nobis possessiones agrorum et vinearum:
and you have given us possession of fields and vineyards.
an et oculos nostros vis eruere?
But will you also tear out our eyes?
“Do not look with favor on their sacrifices.
tu scis quod ne asellum quidem umquam acceperim ab eis,
You know that I have not accepted from them, at any time, so much as a young donkey,
nor have I afflicted any of them.”
Let each one of you take censers,
offering to the Lord two hundred fifty censers.
Let Aaron also hold his censer.”
et coacervassent adversum eos omnem multitudinem ad ostium tabernaculi,
and, having crowded the entire multitude close to them at the door of the tabernacle,
the glory of the Lord appeared to them all.
“Separate yourselves from the midst of this congregation,
so that I may suddenly destroy them.”
But they fell prone on their faces,
“O most strong One, the God of the spirits of all flesh,
num uno peccante, contra omnes ira tua desæviet?
should your anger rage against all, for the sin of one?”
And the Lord said to Moses:
Præcipe universo populo ut separetur a tabernaculis Core
“Instruct the entire people to separate from the tents of Korah,
Surrexitque Moyses, et abiit ad Dathan et Abiron:
And Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram.
And the elders of Israel followed him,
and he said to the crowd,
“Withdraw from the tabernacles of these impious men,
et nolite tangere quæ ad eos pertinent,
and touch nothing which pertains to them,
lest you become involved in their sins.”
Cumque recessissent a tentoriis eorum per circuitum,
And when they had withdrawn from their tents all around,
Dathan et Abiron egressi stabant in introitu papilionum suorum cum uxoribus et liberis,
Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrance of their pavilions, with their wives and children,
In hoc scietis quod Dominus miserit me ut facerem universa quæ cernitis,
“By this shall you know that the Lord has sent me to do all that you discern,
et non ex proprio ea corde protulerim:
and that I have not brought these things out of my own heart:
If these men pass away by the common death of men,
or if they will be visited by a scourge,
of a kind by which others are often visited,
then the Lord did not send me.
sin autem novam rem fecerit Dominus,
But if the Lord accomplishes something new,
ut aperiens terra os suum deglutiat eos
so that the earth opens its mouth and swallows them whole,
et omnia quæ ad illos pertinent,
along with everything that belongs to them,
and they descend alive into the underworld,
then you shall know that they have blasphemed the Lord.”
Therefore, as soon as he had ceased to speak,
dirupta est terra sub pedibus eorum:
the earth broke open under their feet.
devoravit illos cum tabernaculis suis et universa substantia eorum,
it devoured them with their tabernacles and their entire substance.
descenderuntque vivi in infernum operti humo,
And they descended alive, the ground closing around them, into the underworld,
and they perished from the midst of the multitude.
took flight at the clamor of those who were perishing,
“Lest perhaps the earth may swallow us whole also.”
Sed et ignis egressus a Domino interfecit ducentos quinquaginta viros, qui offerebant incensum.
Then, too, a fire, going forth from the Lord, put to death the two hundred fifty men who were offering the incense.
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Præcipe Eleazaro filio Aaron sacerdoti ut tollat thuribula quæ jacent in incendio,
“Instruct Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, to take up the censers which lie in the burning,
and to scatter the fire to one side and another,
in the deaths of these sinners.
And let him form them into plates,
and affix them to the altar,
eo quod oblatum sit in eis incensum Domino,
because incense had been offered in them to the Lord,
ut cernant ea pro signo et monimento filii Israël.
and so that the sons of Israel may discern in them a sign and a memorial.”
Tulit ergo Eleazar sacerdos thuribula ænea,
Therefore, Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers,
in quibus obtulerant hi quos incendium devoravit,
by which those whom the burning devoured had made an offering,
and he formed them into plates,
so that the sons of Israel would have,
quibus commonerentur ne quis accedat alienigena,
thereafter, something to admonish them, lest any stranger,
et qui non est de semine Aaron ad offerendum incensum Domino,
or anyone who is not of the offspring of Aaron, might approach to offer incense to the Lord,
ne patiatur sicut passus est Core,
and lest he endure what happened to Korah,
when the Lord spoke to Moses.
Murmuravit autem omnis multitudo filiorum Israël sequenti die contra Moysen et Aaron,
Then, the following day, the entire multitude of the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron,
“You have put to death the people of the Lord.”
And when there arose a sedition,
Moyses et Aaron fugerunt ad tabernaculum fœderis.
and Aaron fled to the tabernacle of the covenant.
But after they had entered it,
and the glory of the Lord appeared.
And the Lord said to Moses:
“Withdraw from the midst of this multitude,
and I will destroy them immediately.”
And while they were lying on the ground,
et hausto igne de altari, mitte incensum desuper,
and draw fire into it from the altar; place incense upon it,
and continue on, quickly, to the people,
jam enim egressa est ira a Domino,
For already wrath has gone forth from the Lord,
and he had run into the midst of the multitude,
which the burning fire was now destroying,
et stans inter mortuos ac viventes,
And standing between the dead and the living,
Fuerunt autem qui percussi sunt, quatuordecim millia hominum,
But the number of those who were struck down was fourteen thousand men,
absque his qui perierant in seditione Core.
aside from those who had perished in the sedition of Korah.
Reversusque est Aaron ad Moysen ad ostium tabernaculi fœderis postquam quievit interitus.
And Aaron returned to Moses at the door of the tabernacle of the covenant, after the destruction quieted.
